question: Who has been appointed as the Director of the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) in December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cherukumalli Srinivasa Rao**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cherukumalli Srinivasa Rao** has been appointed as the **Director of the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI)** in **December 2024**.
 
• The **Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI)** is a premier national institute for agricultural research, education, and extension under the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR).
 
• Dr. Rao is a distinguished agricultural scientist with expertise in **genetics, crop improvement, and sustainable agriculture practices**.
 
• He has contributed significantly to the development of high-yielding and climate-resilient crop varieties, enhancing food security in India.
 
• The appointment of Dr. Rao aligns with the government’s aim to strengthen agricultural research and innovation for sustainable development in the sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI):**
 
 
• The IARI, popularly known as the **Pusa Institute**, is headquartered in **New Delhi**.
 
• It was established in **1905** and has been pivotal in spearheading the **Green Revolution** in India.
 
• The institute focuses on **crop improvement, resource management, and agricultural engineering**.
 
• It operates under the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), which is the apex body for coordinating agricultural education and research in India.
 
 
 
• **Contributions of Dr. Cherukumalli Srinivasa Rao:**
 
 
• Dr. Rao has extensive experience in **plant breeding and genetics**, specializing in developing improved crop varieties.
 
• He has worked on innovative approaches to address challenges like **climate change, pests, and diseases** in agriculture.
 
• His research has significantly contributed to enhancing the productivity and sustainability of Indian agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR):**
 
 
• ICAR is an autonomous organization under the **Department of Agricultural Research and Education (DARE), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**.
 
• It was established on **16 July 1929**, and its headquarters are in **New Delhi**.
 
• ICAR is responsible for **coordinating, guiding, and managing agricultural research and education** in India.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Agricultural Research:**
 
 
• Agricultural research institutions like IARI play a critical role in ensuring **food security** for a growing population.
 
• Research on climate-resilient crops helps mitigate the impacts of **climate change** on agriculture.
 
• Innovations in sustainable farming practices contribute to **environmental conservation** and resource efficiency.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Achievements of IARI:**
 
 
• The development of high-yielding varieties of rice and wheat that were instrumental in the **Green Revolution**.
 
• Contributions to the development of agro-technologies for enhancing **crop productivity** and sustainability.
 
• Research on biofortification to address **malnutrition** through nutrient-enriched crops.
 
 
 
• **Future Goals:**
 
 
• Strengthening research on **climate-resilient agriculture** to tackle challenges posed by global warming.
 
• Enhancing collaboration with international agricultural research organizations for **knowledge exchange**.
 
• Promoting the adoption of advanced technologies like **genomics, precision farming, and artificial intelligence** in agriculture.
